method: Matched off/on full views at first selected frame, followed by native-pixel crops of all 16 consecutive pairs; no product edits or rendering runs.
pairing: Capture metadata records independent warmed histories and exposure, one advance per identical simulation frame, alternating order, and identical bake deliveries forwarded before either render.

views.observation: AA-on softens ridge tiles and eaves. House silhouette stays aligned across matched views, with less visible pixel stepping; no doubled edge observed.
AA-on softens roof detail while reducing the visible ridge/eave stair pattern. The changing oblique view shows no doubled house edge.

Detached roof, window, and wall silhouettes stay at their matched current positions. No obvious multi-frame debris duplicate or old meteor-head silhouette remains as the head crosses the view. The long emissive ribbon exists in both variants.

limitations: Qualitative static inspection of short 16-frame intervals; this is not a numerical edge-crawl or temporal ghost-length metric.
Clear-sky debris crop and front/side house views do not cover every object, velocity, material, disocclusion, camera cut, or reset.
Bright fire, smoke, and very small objects can hide faint or subpixel ghosts.
These retained earlier-kit captures do not verify the forthcoming c559 production-kit captures.
This audit makes no render-time budget claim.
